current_setup_ticket_separate: ROBOCASA365-SETUP-CPU-ADMISSION.json; no policy weights/constructors allowed there

initializer.excluded: train_state and all other model candidates
initializer.format: original JAX/Orbax params, native public mean/std assets

conversion_proposed.tests: Five genuinely new preprocessing numeric tests and actual conversion/strict-load/reference transform checks only. No old suites.

native_proposed.tasks: OpenDrawer first, at most one prospectively declared ScrubCuttingBoard fallback; no broad search

paired_pilot_proposal.reward_F: full-horizon terminal (expected_score-1)/4 only; GT outside optimizer path

resource_proposal.arms: Separate S and F jobs, concurrently when hardware/scorer capacity permits; separate complete recoveries. Serial scheduling is optional, not a scientific or readiness gate.
resource_proposal.resource_boundary: Concrete proposal only, not a reservation; standing <=8 GPUs/job does not mean default8 or additional authority beyond the chosen matched phase. No aggregate GPU-hour cap is inferred.
resource_proposal.scorer_capacity: Owner binds actual independent repaired scorer capacity/clock; every allocation/wait/failure is charged once, no old balance assumed.

paired_pilot_proposal.early_stop: At a planned fixedDEV boundary, stop both arms if both reach8/8 (exploratory ceiling stop); after iteration6, stop paired continuation if neither gains even one fixedDEV case over its own initial sameDEV baseline at2/4/6. Final8 never participates. This is the stated bounded-pilot futility rule, not statistical evidence of convergence/significance; preserve all outcomes and complete pending recovery.

initial_same_DEV_baseline.reuse_requires: Same actual cases, initializer, normalization, sampler/private action RNG, termination/label timing and input identities. Common native data is not automatically the sameDEV baseline.
initial_same_DEV_baseline.accounting: A proven reused physical case is charged once; reserve is a ceiling, not duplicated consumption.

paired_pilot_proposal.reporting: Exploratory8-case panels: publish success numerators/denominators and the predeclared stop rule; no significance or convergence claim from a one-case increase.

not_done: No model/tensor read or conversion here
No native rollout or scorer call here
No RoboCasa matched PPO runtime qualification or launch here
